* International exposure to Germany, Russia, US and Asia

positions.title: Co-Founder & CTO
positions.description:
Proactive Analytics for eCommerce as never seen before - Divvit will be the eCommerce team that you've always dreamt of hiring.

Our mission is to lead eCommerce managers from data to decision through beautiful software and clever recommendations. Our background is in eCommerce and our specialty is creating a synergy between data, UX and strategy. We help you to understand your performance on all levels from traffic sources to AOV and provide you succinct reasoning for optimization.

Divvit presents structured data as visual statistics and actionable reports. Get a quick overview on the state of your business or dive deeper into problematic areas. All reports are structured into three main categories: Traffic, Conversion and Cost. 

The growing team behind Divvit is based in Stockholm, London, Singapore and Vietnam, needless to say we  support clients anywhere in the world.
